description: Understand repositories, trace dependencies, diagnose bugs, and turn feature requests into implementation plans.

defaultPrompt: Map this repository's architecture and entry points.
Trace the likely cause of this bug through the code.
Turn this feature request into an implementation plan.
interface.longDescription: Ask the Code turns a repository or code snapshot into a practical engineering map. It identifies architecture, entry points, dependencies, data flow, likely failure paths, affected files, implementation steps, tests, and configuration changes. It distinguishes inspected evidence from assumptions and never claims to have accessed a repository that was not provided or connected.

name: ask-the-code
